description: Source code implementing 64-bit optimized elliptic curve point multiplication for P-224 in BoringSSL, including point addition, doubling, scalar multiplication, and field arithmetic in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp224_point_get_affine_coordinates
methods.description: Converts Jacobian coordinates to affine (x, y) coordinates for P-224.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp224_add
methods.description: Adds two elliptic curve points in Jacobian coordinates for P-224.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp224_dbl
methods.description: Doubles an elliptic curve point in Jacobian coordinates for P-224.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp224_make_precomp
methods.description: Precomputes multiples of a point for faster scalar multiplication.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp224_point_mul
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of a point on P-224.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp224_point_mul_base
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of the base point on P-224.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp224_point_mul_public
methods.description: Performs combined scalar multiplication for P-224.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp224_felem_mul
methods.description: Multiplies two field elements in the P-224 field.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp224_felem_sqr
methods.description: Squares a field element in the P-224 field.
